description: This file contains unit tests for the Vertex AI Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine integration, specifically testing ingestion and querying functionalities. It defines a test class inheriting from a base test class, with fixtures for environment validation and methods for configuration and querying of Vertex AI resources.

classes.name: TestRAGVertexAI
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Vertex AI RAG ingestion and query functionalities, inheriting from BaseRAGTest and using pytest fixtures.

methods.name: check_env_vars(self)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that verifies required environment variables for Vertex AI integration are set; skips tests if not.

methods.name: RAGIngestOptions get_base_ingest_options(self)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with Vertex AI-specific ingestion configuration options.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] query_vector_store( self, vector_store_id: str, query: str, )
methods.description: Asynchronous method to perform a retrieval query on the Vertex AI RAG corpus, returning formatted results or skipping if dependencies are missing.

ctags.name: vertexai_init
ctags.pattern: /^            from vertexai import init as vertexai_init$/
